title: Dettifoss Waterfall, Ásbyrgi and Lake Mývatn - Shore Excursion from Húsavík
desc: Explore the best natural attractions of North Iceland by taking the Diamond Circle Tour, a driving route that covers the most captivating sites in the region. Starting from Húsavík, the northern capital of Iceland, embark on a sightseeing journey that takes you through stunning waterfalls, delightful fishing villages, peculiar geological formations, majestic cliffs, and rejuvenating hot springs. Witness the sheer power of the Dettifoss waterfall, be mesmerized by the surreal landscapes of Lake Mývatn, marvel at the breathtaking cliffs of Ásbyrgi canyon, and experience the charm of the seaside village of Húsavík. Accompanied by a knowledgeable local guide, you will learn about the fascinating local folklore, geology, and much more. Join us on the best sightseeing tour that North Iceland has to offer.

title: Reykjavík Whales & Diving
desc: SELF-DRIVE combo tour that includes diving in Silfra with Dive.is and whale watching with Elding! Duration: 9-10 hours (including driving) Time: 8:00 starting with diving / 09:00 starting with wale watching Available: All year round Drive yourself to Þingvellir national park which is about 45 km. from Reykjavík. Diving in the crystal clear glacial water in Silfra with over 100m view of its stunning surroundings is an amazing experience. Adding to that you are swimming between two continents and get an excellent view of the crack separating the European and American continental shells. The total time of diving is approximately 3 hours, including one dive and a view of Silfra Hall, Silfra Chathedral and Silfra Lagoon. Drive yourself to Reykjavík's Old Harbour for the whale watching tour. You are likely to encounter minke whales, dolphins, porpoises and even Humpback whales on the cruise! After exploring the wonders of the whales and seabirds Faxaflói bay offers you return to the harbour approximately 3 hrs. later. -- In order to dive in Silfra, one must either be a certified dry suit diver or be able to provide proof of at least 10 logged dry suit dives within the last two years. The proof must be a written confirmation by an instructor affiliated with an internationally recognised diving organisation. All diving participants will also need to read and sign a "Diving Silfra Medical Statement” and, if necessary, follow the directions regarding a doctor's clearance for the tour. All diving participants will need to read and sign a "Diving Silfra Medical Statement” and, if necessary, follow the directions regarding a doctor's clearance for the tour. To dive in Silfra all participants must be: • At least 18 yrs. old (17 with parental permission) and no older than 65 yrs. • Taller than 150 cm. and weigh at least 45 kg., although no more than 120 kg. and physically fit. • A certified diver at the level of PADI Open Water or equivalent (bring proof of certification). • Ready to wear sometimes tight and constricting dry suit (dry suit diving experience recommended). • Comfortable in water and able to swim. Please check the size chart carefully to make sure you fit the height and weight requirements for dry suit diving. Please note that participants need to bring thermal underwear and thick wool socks. Its also recommended to dress according to weather and bring hat, gloves etc. If participants wear glasses we recommend wearing contact lenses as the masks are not suitable for glasses.

title: FlyOver Iceland and Golden Circle Tour
desc: This is a great choice for those travellers seeking a fun-filled, adventure-packed day. This option will take you to the most famous sights of the Golden Circle, where you will experience in-person the unique wonders of Thingvellir National Park , Geysir Geothermal Area , Gullfoss Waterfall and Kerið Volcanic Crater . Our expert guides will share with you our viking history, exciting folklore and geological marvels. After the tour you will then be transported to the old habour area of Reykjavik where you can virtually travel over the whole of the country at FlyOver Iceland ! The state-of-the-art technology replicates the feeling of flying, and selects the most spectacular must-see locations in the country. The tour combination will enable you to see all the most famous sites, as well as those hidden gems known only to locals. This is the perfect choice for those who short on time and who want to see it all, and those travellers seeking inspiration for their next adventure. We are honoured to offer this unique tour option that combines the absolute best of Iceland.

title: Forest Lagoon & Goðafoss Waterfall Tour from Akureyri
desc: Embark on this captivating shore excursion tour from Akureyri - an unforgettable 5 hour experience. Prepare to be enchanted we combine natural beauty with a luxury wellnes experience. Your first stop is the awe-inspiring Goðafoss Waterfall, often referred to as the "Waterfall of the Gods." Marvel at the sheer power and beauty of this natural wonder as you stand in awe of the cascading waters plunging into the crystal-clear pool below. Feel the mist on your face and breathe in the fresh, invigorating air as you capture breathtaking photos of this iconic sight. Just before we reach Akureyri once more, we make our second stop at The Forest Lagoon, an impressive geothermal spa with views overlooking Eyja Fjord and Akureyri itself. Try the various lagoons, cold plunges, and sauna in beautiful surroundings. While away a coule of hours here before your shuttle back to the port. Return to Akureyri with memories to last a lifetime, feeling inspired by the natural beauty and cultural heritage of Iceland. Whether you're a nature lover or simply seeking an unforgettable experience, this 5 hour tour promises an adventure filled with wonder and discovery.

title: Glacier Snowmobiling from Reykjavík
desc: Get ready for the ride of a lifetime with pickup from Reykjavík! We'll kick things off by cruising to Skjol, then buckle up as we hop into our specialized Super Jeep for the ultimate thrill ride to Langjökull Glacier. But hey, the journey itself is an adventure you won't forget! Once we arrive at our glacier base camp, it's time to suit up in all the gear you need for snowmobiling – think snowmobile suits, gloves, ski-googles, a cozy balaclava, and a helmet to top it all off. But wait, there's more! Your pro snowmobiling guide will give you the lowdown on how to ride like a boss before we hit the snow. Langjökull Glacier isn't just any old icy landscape – it's a mesmerizing wonderland filled with colossal ice-filled volcanic craters and jaw-dropping views of the Icelandic interior. From the slopes of Langjökull, you'll be treated to breathtaking sights like the towering Eiríksjökull glacier, the majestic Hofsjökull glacier, and the picturesque Kerlingafjöll Mountain range. Get ready to soak in the scenery and make memories that'll last a lifetime – this adventure is one for the books!

title: Golden Circle & Laugarás Geothermal Lagoon Small Group Tour
desc: The Golden Circle is the name commonly given to a combination of three sites of special significance in the west of Iceland. These sites are Þingvellir National Park , Geysir geothermal area, and Gullfoss waterfall . Your tour finishes up with a visit to one of Iceland´s most stunning thermal spas, Laugarás Lagoon . Your Lerki entrance ticket is included in your booking. Enjoy a free drink at the lagoon bar, and experience the cold plunge, saunas, and linger on the stunning views. The premium Golden Circle tour takes your little group of maximum 19 passengers around in a comfortable minibus. We visit all above mentioned places of interest and maybe more, as we endeavour to share with you some of the highlights of Icelandic history and nature all in one magnificent route through the Icelandic countryside.

title: Golden Circle & Secret Lagoon Tour
desc: The Golden Circle combined with the Secret Lagoon is is a combo tour not to be missed. Not only does it combine two fantastic activities into one day but also grants an earlier admission to the lagoon than what is typically available, making you able to soak in the hot waters out of the crowds. The Golden Circle with Secret Lagoon combines perfectly the highlights of the area and the wellness activity, still keeping an easy going and relaxed pace for the day . The day starts at the colourful Kerid Crater Lake before heading onwards to the Secret Lagoon . The lagoon is alimented by 38-40 degree celsius warm waters which will rest your mind, body and soul. After a good time relaxing in the lagoon we continue the Golden Circle route visiting the geothermal paradise of Geysir , the magnificence of the Gullfoss waterfall and Þingvellir National Park . This combo is one of the most popular tours in Iceland and once you have been on it you will certainly understand why!

title: Pearl Tour - Golden Circle Super Jeep Tour & Snowmobiling
desc: The Golden Circle tour allows visitors to get in touch with some of Iceland’s most famous and exciting natural phenomena. Our first stop is at Þingvellir National Park, which is one of Iceland's most significant historical sites. It's the home of Iceland’s first parliament which was founded in 930 AD. From Þingvellir we head along mountain tracks toward the world-renowned geothermal area around Geysir Hot Spring, the one spouting hot spring on Earth after which all other spouting hot springs are named. From there we continue on to Gullfoss (“the Golden waterfall”) where your proximity to its edge is so close you can feel the spray of the glacial water on your face. Next, we kick the action into higher gear to get even closer to Iceland’s nature and go for a one-hour snowmobile tour on Langjökull, Europe’s second-largest glacier.

title: Grand Golden Circle & Horse Riding Tour
desc: Make the most of your time in Iceland and combine two of the most popular tours available; Horse-back riding on the Iceland horse; and the most popular sight-seeing tour in Iceland, the Golden Circle. Join our friends at Laxnes Horse farm, meet the Icelandic horse and canter through the Icelandic countryside, passing valleys, rivers and hills along the way. In the afternoon, you'll be picked up at the horse farm by our Golden Circle bus. We make stops at some of Iceland´s most treasured natural wonders, namely the UNESCO heritage site Thingvellir national park, Geysir Hot Springs and Gullfoss waterfall.

title: Glacier Lagoon & Diamond Beach Tour From Djúpivogur Port
desc: Departing from the quiet harbour town of Djúpivogu r, this seven-hour shore excursion is crafted with cruise-ship guests in mind and takes you along Iceland’s striking southeast coast. You’ll travel southwards, following a route that reveals expansive sea views and the immense broad ice-cap of Vatnajökull looming on the horizon. The first stop is the breathtaking Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon — here enormous icebergs, calved from the glacier’s southern edge, drift serenely in the lagoon’s still waters before eventually making their way out to the sea. From there, the tour visits the nearby Diamond Beach (also known as Fellsfjara), a black-sand shoreline where glittering chunks of glacier ice wash up and create a surreal contrast of crystal ice against dark volcanic sand. Finally, on the return, the journey stops at the scenic Hvalnes Peninsula with its lonely lighthouse and the dramatic horn-shaped peak of Eystrahorn mountain standing vigil. Throughout the tour you’ll be guided by an experienced local guide, enjoy free WiFi on board, and be dropped back in time for your ship’s departure. Bring waterproof outer layers, warm accessories and comfortable shoes—and don’t forget to carry some snacks, as lunch isn’t provided

title: Grand Golden Circle & Puffin Watching Tour
desc: Make the most of your time in Iceland by combining two of the most popular tours available: a puffin boat safari and the Golden Circle, the country's most popular sightseeing tour. In the morning, we cruise Faxaflóa bay in search of the sea life that calls it home. In the afternoon, join our Grand Golden Circle bus tour from Bus stop # 4, adjacent to the old harbour. We stop at some of Iceland´s most treasured natural wonders, namely Thingvellir National Park, Geysir, and Gullfoss waterfall. Our final stop of the day is the volcanic crater lake at Kerið.

title: BT-Lake Myvatn, Hot-Springs & Godafoss Waterfall Tour from Akureyri - German
desc: Explore the exceptional Mývatn area of Northern Iceland, known for its captivating geological features, volcanic landscapes, and thermal springs. The Mývatn lake is brimming with diverse bird species, drawn to the plentiful fish thriving in the nutrient-dense waters. Additionally, the lake is encompassed by a plethora of breathtaking sights such as the remarkable lava formations of Dimmuborgir and the Skutustadir craters. Along the way, we will also pause to admire the awe-inspiring Goðafoss waterfall, also known as the "waterfall of the gods."

title: Landmannalaugar Hiking, Nature Bath & Háifoss Tour
desc: Landmannalaugar is one of the hidden gems of Iceland. Most visitors to our shores stick to more easily accessible regions such as the Golden Circle or the southern coastline. Landmannalaugar on the other hand requires special 4x4 vehicles to access. This extra effort is well worth it for the astounding and unique landscapes that await you. From hiking trails through ancient lava fields and rolling rhyolite hills, bathing in hot-springs to beautiful sites such as Hjálparafoss waterfall and Hnausapollur volcanic crater lake, there is something for everyone on our Landmannalaugar tour. Join us then on our highland bus and visit the beautiful Landmannalaugar. Háifoss & Granni Waterfalls We make a stop at these waterfalls both of which drop over 100 meters to the canyon below. Háifoss is the larger both in height and volume and is in fact Iceland´s 4th highest falls. Granni, literally meaning neighbor cascades over a few levels before reaching the bottom. The falls are the end point of the Fossá river, itself a tributary of the larger Þjórsá river. The falls are most voluminous is spring when the snow is the valleys above begins the melt. This is the only day tour that visits Háifoss. Hjálparafoss waterfall Our first stop is on the way to Landmannalaugar is Hjálparafoss. Located in Þjórsárdalur valley, Hjálparafoss is a double pronged waterfall framed by stunning basalt formations, remnants of an eruption at the nearby Hekla volcano. The falls are actually the culmination and meeting point of two rivers, the Þjórsá (Iceland´s longest river) and the Fossá. The pool which forms at the base of the falls in olden times offered relief and water to weary travelers from the north, which led to its name, which translates to Help Falls in English. Hnausapollur Volcanic Crater Lake This crater lake is an underappreciated gem. Naturally places that are easy to reach attract more eyes and hype but Iceland is dotted with many hidden gems like this crater. Though less famous than the similar Kerið, Hnausapollur is well worth a visit. This crater was formed during the massive simultaneous eruption of Barðabunga and Torfajökull volcanoes, over 1200 years ago. Also known as Bláhlynur, a reference to the turquoise blue hue of the water. Landmannalaugar Landmannalaugar is a highland region which forms part of the 470m2 Fjallabak nature reserve. The area usually becomes accessible for day tours in June, depending on the degree of havoc caused to the roads by the spring meltwaters. This rough F-road is one to avoid in anything but 4x4 vehicles. Luckily for you, our sturdy highland bus is up to the challenge. Famous for its colorful unique terrain with rhyolite hills and lava fields, this is a hiker´s paradise. Your guide will take you on the trail with wonderful photo opportunities and a well-earned sense of accomplishment your reward. And what better way to end a hike than to soak your weary feet in a hot-spring. Just remember to bring your swimsuit! Landmannalaugar also serves as the start and end point for Iceland´s most popular trek, the 55km Laugarvegur trail to Thorsmörk. After our time together in Landmannalaugar, we embark on the journey back west, arriving to the city in time for you to catch a late dinner.

title: Ice Cave and Glacier Tour in Glacier Monster Truck from Gullfoss
desc: Our enthusiastic and knowledgeable guides will lead you through Langjökull Glacier's breathtaking landscape. Discover the wonders of glaciers , listen to interesting facts about glaciers, and hear stories of the Icelandic Highlands. Enjoy the comfort and safety of our enormous Monster Trucks. With the panoramic windows, you have a spectacular view, and with the huge tires, the ride is smoother than you think! Explore the heart of the Glacier while walking through the NATURAL ice cave. The ice is often lined with black volcanic ash from eruptions long ago and is embedded in the ice. Don't forget your camera - this mesmerizing landscape offers unparalleled photo opportunities! Highlights: Monster Truck: Experience a comfortable and safe journey with panoramic views in the biggest glacier trucks. Langjökull Glacier Exploration: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Iceland's second-largest glacier. NATURAL Ice Cave: Dive into the the dynamic beauty of Langjökull Glacier and visit the "Neptune ice cave" Unique Natural Formations: See the ice cave's crystal walls lined with volcanic ash, offering unparalleled photo opportunities. Glacier Knowledge: Learn fascinating facts and stories about glaciers and the Icelandic Highlands from enthusiastic guides. 🧥 Pro Tip: We recommend bringing rainproof gear and waterproof boots or shoes — not just for our tour, but for any adventure during your Icelandic holiday. Embrace the elements like a local!

title: Red Glacier Monster Truck Tour - Unique Langjökull Glacier Tour from Gullfoss
desc: Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime adventure aboard our Monster Sleipnir Trucks, ensuring comfort and safety as we journey to the breathtaking Langjökull, Iceland's second-largest glacier. Our knowledgeable and local guides will lead you through this stunning natural wonder . Listen to interesting facts about glaciers, hear authentic stories of the Icelandic Highlands , and dive into the fascinating world of Nordic Mythology. We stop at a scenic spot on the glacier with stunning views. Here you can enjoy at our Glacier pop-up Cafe - hot cocoa, coffee or tea, and Kleinur (an Icelandic pastry), and taste the purest water straight from the glacier. For thrill-seekers, don't miss the chance to sled down the slopes or play golf atop the glacier*. This Icelandic glacier tour offers lasting memories and fun! Delve into beauty, gather fascinating knowledge, and capture memorable photos – an unforgettable experience is guaranteed! Highlights: Langjökull Glacier: Experience the magnificence of Iceland's second-largest glacier. Sleipnir Monster Trucks: Comfortable and thrilling ride with panoramic views. Icelandic Highlands: Dive into the fascinating landscapes and Nordic mythology. Glacier Pop-up Cafe: Enjoy hot cocoa, tea, and "Kleinur" (Icelandic pastry) with glacier views. Pure Glacier Water: Taste the cleanest, freshest water directly from the glacier. Fun Activities: Opportunity for sledding and glacier golf* (weather permitting). *Activities subject to weather and glacier conditions. Footnote: 🌧️ Rain or Shine – the Adventure Goes On Even when it rains, the glacier and Highlands take on a dramatic beauty that’s well worth the journey. You’ll stay warm and dry inside our comfortable Sleipnir Truck — but you're free to step outside and explore for as long as you like! We serve the hot cocoa then inside! Having said that, in early autumn (Sep & Oct) the weather might be more challenging, and there are days we need to consider to cancel the tour due to weather. 🧥 Pro Tip: We recommend bringing rainproof gear and waterproof boots or shoes — not just for our tour, but for any adventure during your Icelandic holiday. Embrace the elements like a local!

title: Perlan Ice Cave, Northern Lights Planetarium & Golden Circle Tour
desc: The Perlan Museum and Golden Circle Tour is a great option for those who want to combine all the highlights of the Golden Circle and a world class exhibition at Perlan dome, The Wonders of Iceland . Begin your day by joining our Golden Circle day tour on a true adventure with one of our enthusiastic guides. You will explore, inhale and experience the unique wonders on the Golden Circle; Thingvellir National Park , Geysir Geothermal Area , Gullfoss Waterfall and Kerið Volcanic Crater . After the conclusion of your Golden Circle tour, you will be dropped off at Perlan ffor the second part of your day. The interactive museum is one of the most ambitious exhibitions in Iceland where scientific wonders come alive all around you; glaciers, volcanoes, oceanic wonders, seabirds and northern lights. The Wonders of Iceland give you a proper insight into the forces of Icelandic nature before you are picked up to feel Icelandic nature on you own skin.

title: Snæfellsnes Peninsula Tour from Grundarfjordur Port
desc: Embark on an unforgettable day tour from Grundarfjörður to Snæfellsnes, exploring the stunning landscapes and captivating landmarks that define this magical peninsula. Your journey begins at Grundarfjörður port, where you'll be greeted by the breathtaking silhouette of Kirkjufell, one of Iceland's most iconic mountains. First on the itinerary is Kirkjufellsfoss, a majestic waterfall at the base of Kirkjufell. Marvel at the synergy of the mountain and the falls, capturing postcard-perfect moments against the backdrop of nature's grandeur. Continue your adventure to Djúpalónssandur, a black-sand beach adorned with fascinating remnants of a shipwreck. Feel the ancient spirits of the sea as you explore the mystical stones scattered along the shore, each with its own unique historical significance. As you travel along the coastline, Lóndrangar will emerge on the horizon – colossal basalt rock pinnacles rising dramatically from the sea. Gaze in awe at these natural sculptures and appreciate the raw power of geological forces that shaped the rugged coastline. Arnarstapi, a quaint fishing village, beckons with its charm and scenic coastal beauty. Stroll along the coastal cliffs, breathe in the crisp sea air, and witness the resident birdlife nesting in the cliffs. Your journey concludes at Búðir, a picturesque location featuring the iconic black church set against a backdrop of lava fields and the Snæfellsjökull glacier. Take in the spiritual ambiance and capture the timeless allure of this historic site. As you return to Grundarfjörður port, reflect on a day filled with natural wonders, cultural treasures, and the undeniable magic that is Snæfellsnes. This day tour promises a symphony of sights and experiences, creating lasting memories of Iceland's awe-inspiring beauty.

title: Reykjavík Whales & Snorkeling
desc: SELF DRIVE - Morning whale watching with Elding and an afternoon snorkeling with Dive.is Available: 1 February - 31 November Duration: Approximately 6-7 hrs. total Time: Whale Watching at 09:00 & Snorkeling at 14:00 Whale Watching Meet us at Elding's ticket office at 8:45 where you will exchange your voucher for admission tickets and from there we will show you to the boat. On board you will find several outdoor viewing platforms and a large indoor saloon with an on board café where you can buy light refreshments. We also have basic bathroom facilities and a cloak room where you can borrow one of our blankets or overalls on colder days. You can either stay outside in the fresh air or stay inside the heated lounge and observe the views from within, through our large panoramic windows. In summer we can expect to see minke whales at their most abundant, along with white-beaked dolphins, harbour porpoises and even humpback whales. After exploring the wonders of the whales and seabirds Faxaflói offers you return to the harbour around 12:00. Snorkeling Drive to Þingvellir national park and meet the Dive.is team at Silfra parking lot before the tour starts at 14:00. On site you will be geared up by your tour guide and shown the appropriate snorkeling methods. Once you are in the water the make sure to enjoy every moment - Snorkeling in the crystal clear glacial water in Silfra with over 100m view of its stunning surroundings is an amazing experience. Adding to that you are swimming between two continents and get an excellent view of the crack separating the European and American continental shells. The total time of snorkeling is approximately 1 hour. After the snorkeling you will be offered a well deserved and very welcome hot chocolate and cookies before your journey back to Reykjavík. All snorkeling participants must read and sign the "Snorkeling Silfra Medical Statement" and if necessary, follow the directions regarding a doctor's clearance for the tour. To snorkel in Silfra all participants must: • Be no younger or older than 12-65 years old. • Be between 150cm-200cm and 45kg-120kg. • Must not be pregnant and be physically fit. • Be ready to wear something tight and constricting dry suit. • Be comfortable in water and be able to swim. Check the size chart carefully to make sure you fit the height and weight requirements for dry suit snorkeling. Participants need to bring thermal underwear and thick wool socks. Its also recommended to dress according to weather and bring hat, gloves etc. If participants wear glasses we recommend wearing contact lenses as the masks are not suitable for glasses.

title: South Coast & Katla Ice Cave
desc: Experience the wonders of Iceland in a single day on our action-packed tour, starting and ending in the vibrant city of Reykjavík. Brace yourself for a day of natural marvels, from the mysterious depths of Katla Ice Cave to the thundering cascades of Skógafoss and Seljalandsfoss waterfalls. Departing from Reykjavík, our journey takes us southeast towards the charming village of Vík. Admire the diverse landscapes, from lava fields to coastal cliffs. Arriving in Vík, we'll embark on a thrilling Katla Ice Cave tour. Venture into the heart of the Mýrdalsjökull Glacier, where a world of shimmering ice formations awaits. Our expert guides will lead you through the cave, sharing fascinating insights into the glacial environment and its geological history. Marvel at the crystal blue hues and intricate ice sculptures that make this cave a natural masterpiece. Returning to Reykjavík, we'll make two unforgettable stops at two of Iceland's most famous waterfalls. Skógafoss Waterfall: Witness the sheer power of Skógafoss as it plunges 60 meters over a rocky cliff. Feel the mist on your face and ascend the staircase for a panoramic view of the surrounding landscapes. Seljalandsfoss Waterfall: Conclude the day with a visit to Seljalandsfoss, a picturesque waterfall with a unique feature – a walking path that takes you behind the curtain of falling water. Immerse yourself in the beauty and capture the perfect shot of this natural spectacle. As the day draws to a close, we'll return to Reykjavík, leaving you with memories of Iceland's diverse landscapes, a mesmerizing ice cave adventure, and the powerful allure of its cascading waterfalls. This one-day tour promises a whirlwind of natural beauty and excitement in the land of fire and ice.

title: Glacier Lagoon (Jökulsárlón) & South Coast Tour with boat ride
desc: Join us on a glacial mission and sail in-between the icebergs on our Glacier Lagoon tour including the sailing experience. This 14 hours tour takes you straight from the capital to Iceland's icy treasure and allows you to explore the ever changing glacial landscape, colours and forms. The Glacier lagoon, Jökulsárlón leaves no one untouched with its stunning beauty and the exploration by boat , in between the icebergs truly adds to the experience. Part of the glacial wonders, and not to be missed, is the black volcanic and ice speckled, Diamond Beach . You will also visit the nearby Fjallsárlón glacier lagoon (if time allows) and the hidden gem Stjórnarfoss waterfall. The scenic landscape along the South Coast screams out for a couple of mandatory stops. We'll enjoy optional dinner and beach time at Vík Village where Reynisdrangar seastacks and petrified trolls run the scene. Seljalandsfoss waterfall that welcomes us with it's mighty drop, fresh water and a quick adventure behind the falls when conditions are good, before we head back to civilisation.

title: South Coast & Northern Lights Tour
desc: It was Led Zeppelin who once sang about Iceland “We come from the land of the ice and snow from the midnight sun, where the hot springs flow” in their famous hit ‘Immigrant song’. These lyrics come from the reputation Iceland has as being a country born of fire and Ice, a reputation that will become incredibly clear to you as you journey along our countries southern coast where glaciers and volcanoes await you. On what is perhaps one of our most popular day tours you will get to see black sand beaches at Reynisfjara , glorious waterfalls (including one with a unique surprise) in the form of Skogafoss and Seljalandsfoss , Glaciers , Volcanoes and the sleepy little village of Vik . For nature lovers, this is NOT a tour to miss!

desc: It was Led Zeppelin who once sang about Iceland “We come from the land of the ice and snow from the midnight sun, where the hot springs flow” in their famous hit ‘Immigrant song’. Your Pure Pass ticket includes the 7-Step Ritual program .

title: Volcano Hike & Northern Lights Tour
desc: Hike to an erupting Fagradalsfjall Volcano in Geldingadalur Valley for a tour of a lifetime from Reykjavík. To capture the most magical moments of visiting a volcano site we offer afternoon and evening departures. Our expert tour guide will make this experience safe and makes sure you get the best views possible. The hike is around 8 km and 300 m elevation but this can vary depending on conditions which route is chosen to the Volcano.

title: Westman Islands Puffins, Volcano & Elephant Rock Tour
desc: This wonderful 2.5-hour shore excursion tour offers visitors a memorable introduction to Heimæy island’s dramatic nature and history. Heimæy is the largest island in the Vestmannaeyjar , The tour begins with scenic coastal views, including the famous Elephant Rock , a basalt sea formation that remarkably resembles an elephant dipping its trunk into the Atlantic. This natural sculpture, shaped by volcanic activity and relentless ocean erosion, is one of the island’s most photographed landmarks. The excursion continues to Stórhöfði , a dramatic southern headland known for its sweeping ocean vistas and thriving colony of Atlantic puffin during the summer months. Here we cansee puffins perched on grassy cliffs or flying in from the sea with small fish in their beaks, offering excellent opportunities for wildlife observation and photography. Next, we learn about the dramatic 1973 eruption of Eldfell volcano. This eruption reshaped Heimaey and nearly destroyed the town. From nearby viewpoints, visitors can appreciate both the power of Iceland’s volcanic landscape and the resilience of the island community. The journey concludes with our visit to Skansinn , the island’s historic fortification area. This site features Iceland’s oldest church and cultural landmarks that reflect centuries of maritime life and trade in the Westman Islands

title: Akureyri Classic Whale Watching
desc: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure as we set sail from Akureyri, with the towering Súlur mountain watching over us, and head into the breathtaking Eyjafjord. As we speed past the stunning landscapes, with the island of Hrísey to the north and charming towns dotting the shores, keep your eyes peeled for the rich variety of birdlife that fills the skies. The real stars of the show are the majestic "Eyjafjord Humpback Whales", known for their spectacular breaches and tail slaps, which frequent these waters alongside other remarkable marine species such as minke whales, white-beaked dolphins and harbour porpoises, to name a few. Our high speed, specially modified whale watching ship ensures you won’t miss a moment of the action, offering unparalleled views from our cinema-styled platforms. With expert marine biologist naturalist on hand to share their knowledge, this is your chance to experience the wild beauty of Iceland in a way few ever do!

title: Reykjavík Classic Whale Watching
desc: Venture into Faxaflói bay with our expert crew and specially trained marine biologist naturalists. Led by our passionate crew, you will explore the whales of Reykjavík and learn about the incredible wildlife that call Iceland their home. Encounter a variety of whale species, such as humpback whales, minke whales, white-beaked dolphins and harbour porpoises. If you're lucky, you might even catch a glimpse of majestic killer whales, fin whales, or long-finned pilot whales! The bay is even full of birdlife , from charming puffins to northern gannets and arctic terns, the skies are teeming with life. Watch as these incredible birds dive and feast on the abundant fish that thrive in the bay. Surrounding landscapes offer a beautiful contrast to the vast sea, with stunning mountains on the horizon creating a picturesque backdrop. While summer brings an abundance of life to the bay, each winter continues to surprise us with its own unique encounters. Our ongoing research shows that numerous whales inhabit the area all year round, making every season an ideal time to explore these nutrient rich waters! Make the most of your day by combining this activity with Puffin Watching in the summer, or Northern Lights Cruise in winter! Alternatively, you can book our Premium Whale Watching for a more exclusive experience, or explore our combo tours if you're seeking even more adventures!

title: Grand Golden Circle & Whale Watching Tour
desc: Make the most of your time in Iceland and combine two of the most popular tours available; a whale watching boat safari; and the most popular sight-seeing tour in Iceland, the Golden Circle. We cruise Faxaflóa bay in search of the sea life whom call it home. Minke whales are the most commonly spotted creatures along with seals and dolphins. Rarer, but spotted semi regularly, are Orca whales. In the afternoon, join our Grand Golden Circle bus tour from Bus stop # 4, adjacent to the old harbour. We make stops at some of Iceland´s most treasured natural wonders, namely Thingvellir national park, Geysir and Gullfoss waterfall. Our final stop of the day is the volcanic crater lake at Kerið.
